caption: Basilica of Santa Caterina, Galatina
composition: Ornate Romanesque-Gothic portal and rose window in pale limestone · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera stands on the cobbled square facing the Basilica of Santa Caterina's pale limestone facade in the bright 08:47 morning. The deeply carved Romanesque-Gothic portal fills the left of the frame, its concentric arches and sculpted columns glowing in the sun, while the enormous rose window dominates the right, its stone tracery radiating like a wheel. Weathered town buildings close in at the far left, and the clear blue sky sets off the warm honey tones of the stone.
